current_honest_reading: The current sharp blocker is no longer generic action-schema shape.
It is the missing schema-domain admission / nonidentification boundary for the new T213/T216 -> alpha_s schema route.
F820 freezes that exact missing object without promoting the current lane into the alpha_s schema domain.
recommended_next_move: Build one narrow probe testing whether lawful schema-domain admission or continued nonidentification can be justified from current exports without silent domain identification.
